Name: Marnie Buys Back Your Pail and Shears
Author: ASLaneZero
Description:
[center][img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/41578/41578-1769192276-102434150.png[/img][/center]

[list]
[*]Does exactly what it says on the tin![/*]
[*]You are now able to sell your unwanted Milk Pail and Shears back to Marnie.[/*]
[*]This is intended to give you the option to clear out your clutter after Autograbbers are installed.[/*]
[/list]
This mod is included in the [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/34612][/url][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/34612]Small Mods Pack[/url] (though a download/endorse is always appreciated)!

[list]
[*]Stardew Valley 1.6+[/*]
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400]SMAPI[/url]﻿[/*]
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url]﻿[/*]
[/list]
[center][img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/41578/41578-1769192276-495950343.png[/img][/center]

[list]
[*]If installing manually, delete the previous version and extract [CP] Marnie Buys Back Your Pail and Shears to your mods folder.[/*]
[*]If using Mod Organiser, load the .zip file into your mod manager of choice and install as usual.[/*]
[*]If using a different mod manager... do whatever it is you usually do![/*]
[/list]
